data.name: LZ_Sight_Borrowed_Light
data.value: Everything glows there,[pause=10] except what should.[pause=0] Your own shadow is missing.

data.name: LZ_Sight_Clearwater_Ford
data.value: The current runs backwards,[pause=10] and the wind smells of snow where there is no snow.

data.name: LZ_Sight_Colossus_Quarry
data.value: Six golden veins run beneath the stone.[pause=10] When they light up together,[pause=10] the ground breathes.

data.name: LZ_Sight_Dead_Hours
data.value: Spring leaves and autumn leaves fall from the same tree,[pause=10] at the same time.

data.name: LZ_Sight_Ember_Vigil
data.value: The ash has stayed warm there so long that it turned to stone.

data.name: LZ_Sight_First_Cradle
data.value: There is nothing to see there.[pause=10] That is precisely what should worry you.

data.name: LZ_Sight_Given_Life
data.value: The antlers of a dead tree have blossomed there,[pause=10] and the flowers are blue.

data.name: LZ_Sight_High_Conductor
data.value: Your feathers,[pause=10] your fur,[pause=10] your scales stand on end before you hear a thing.

data.name: LZ_Sight_Hour_That_Lags
data.value: Raindrops fall too slowly there to ever actually land.

data.name: LZ_Sight_Kept_Feeling
data.value: Your reflection smiles a second after you do.

data.name: LZ_Sight_Last_Resolve
data.value: There's no railing,[pause=10] no fence,[pause=10] and yet nobody has ever fallen.

data.name: LZ_Sight_Long_Ash
data.value: A single footprint has stayed intact there,[pause=10] and it is still hot.

data.name: LZ_Sight_Ninth_Summit
data.value: The air is too thin to shout in,[pause=10] and the clouds pass below your feet.

data.name: LZ_Sight_Quiet_Ledger
data.value: The walls are covered in marks you recognise without being able to read them.

data.name: LZ_Sight_Rainbow_Ash
data.value: The embers are seven colours,[pause=10] and the grass grows back while you watch.

data.name: LZ_Sight_Reverse_Slope
data.value: Your shadow walks ahead of you there,[pause=10] and it doesn't wait.

data.name: LZ_Sight_Soft_Sleep
data.value: Moonlight lingers there in broad daylight,[pause=10] laid over the grass like a sheet.

data.name: LZ_Sight_Spatial_Hill
data.value: Runes carved into the ground itself turn slowly around a centre that is too bright.[pause=10] Distance lies there.

data.name: LZ_Sight_Stone_Argument
data.value: Three enormous blocks lean against one another there,[pause=10] and not one gives way.

data.name: LZ_Sight_Storm_Bell
data.value: The rocks are split from above,[pause=10] every one of them the same way.

data.name: LZ_Sight_Sunken_Choir
data.value: The tide rises in rings there,[pause=10] from the open sea,[pause=10] towards one exact point.

data.name: LZ_Sight_Thawed_Step
data.value: The air is so cold it cracks,[pause=10] but the stone,[pause=10] somehow,[pause=10] is warm.

data.name: LZ_Sight_Unsaid_Wishes
data.value: The ground is covered in shining dust,[pause=10] and every grain was once a wish.

data.name: LZ_Sight_Upturned_Dream
data.value: Nothing casts a shadow there,[pause=10] because everything already is one.

data.name: LZ_Sight_Verdant_Oath
data.value: The vines have grown back in a ring,[pause=10] as if someone were standing guard around a memory.

data.name: MT7_Noctowl_001
data.value: Ah...[pause=15] there you are.[pause=20] I suppose you have questions.

data.name: MT7_Noctowl_002
data.value: You saw the Heart, didn't you?[pause=25] What it's become.

data.name: MT7_Noctowl_003
data.value: Then it's time I told you...[pause=30] where life comes from.

data.name: MT7_Noctowl_004
data.value: The Genesis...[pause=20] I never thought I'd tell it one day.[pause=30] And yet.

data.name: MT7_Noctowl_005
data.value: What happened to that Heart...[pause=25] must never happen again.

data.name: MT7_Noctowl_006
data.value: You did it.[pause=20] The Titan has fallen,[pause=15] the Heart beats again.

data.name: MT7_Noctowl_007
data.value: I'm proud of you.[pause=30] More than you can imagine.

data.name: MT7_Noctowl_008
data.value: Stay vigilant.[pause=20] The ruins don't reveal all their secrets at once.

data.name: MT7_Tropius_001
data.value: Haha![pause=10] YOU did it![pause=15] The Titan of the Ruins!

data.name: MT7_Tropius_002
data.value: I knew you were special from the day you joined the guild.

data.name: MT7_Tropius_003
data.value: Rest a while.[pause=25] You've earned it.

data.name: MT7_Tropius_004
data.value: The expedition is over,[pause=10] but something tells me this is just the beginning for you.

data.name: MT7_Tropius_005
data.value: Keep training.[pause=20] The world needs teams like yours.

data.name: MT7_Tropius_006
data.value: The expedition awaits![pause=10] Go see Phileas for the details.

data.name: MT7_Audino_001
data.value: Oh![pause=10] You're back from the ruins![pause=15] I was so worried!

data.name: MT7_Audino_002
data.value: Let me check that you're not hurt...[pause=20] No, everything's fine.

data.name: MT7_Audino_003
data.value: You're truly the most incredible team I've ever seen.

data.name: MT7_Audino_004
data.value: You fell...[pause=20] But you came back. That's all that matters.

data.name: MT7_Audino_005
data.value: Take the time to heal before going back,[pause=10] okay?

data.name: MT7_Audino_006
data.value: The infirmary is ready if you need it![pause=10] Though... I hope you don't.

data.name: MT7_Snubbull_001
data.value: By all the crystals...[pause=20] The Heart of the Ruins was ALIVE?

data.name: MT7_Snubbull_002
data.value: I'm telling EVERYONE at the Kec Shop![pause=10] Well...[pause=15] those who care.

data.name: MT7_Snubbull_003
data.value: The Cloven Ruins, huh?[pause=15] I heard it's even worse than the Tunnel.

data.name: MT7_Snubbull_004
data.value: Be careful in there.[pause=25] I need customers, you know!

data.name: MT7_Snubbull_005
data.value: The stand is open![pause=10] If you've got Poké, that is.

data.name: MT7_Zigzagoon_001
data.value: You beat Regigigas![pause=15] My family won't believe it!

data.name: MT7_Zigzagoon_002
data.value: I'm proud to be in the same guild as you,[pause=20] woof.

data.name: MT7_Zigzagoon_003
data.value: Keep fighting![pause=10] The guild needs teams like yours.

data.name: MT7_Relicanth_001
data.value: So...[pause=30] now you know.[pause=20] The story of Mew.

data.name: MT7_Relicanth_002
data.value: I heard it long ago.[pause=25] It hasn't changed.

data.name: MT7_Relicanth_003
data.value: The Hearts are more fragile than one thinks.[pause=30] Protect them.

data.name: MT7_Relicanth_004
data.value: The Heart of the Ruins...[pause=25] I've felt it weakening for moons.

data.name: MT7_Relicanth_005
data.value: Go see it with your own eyes.[pause=30] And come back to tell me.

data.name: MT7_Relicanth_006
data.value: The currents speak of ancient ruins...[pause=25] Be careful.

data.name: MT7_Bisharp_001
data.value: Regigigas vaincu.[pause=20] Impressionnant.[pause=30] Vraiment.

data.name: MT7_Bisharp_002
data.value: The guild is lucky to have you.[pause=25] Don't abuse it.

data.name: MT7_Bisharp_003
data.value: The Cloven Ruins are a risk zone.[pause=20] Officially.

data.name: MT7_Bisharp_004
data.value: Be careful in there.[pause=30] I don't want to organize a search party.

data.name: MT7_Bisharp_005
data.value: Metano's safety is my priority.[pause=20] Report any suspicious behavior.

data.name: MT7_Ledian_001
data.value: You survived the Cloven Ruins![pause=15] Your technique must have improved.

data.name: MT7_Ledian_002
data.value: The dojo has new challenges for you.[pause=20] Come whenever you want.

data.name: MT7_Ledian_003
data.value: Training is the key![pause=10] The dojo is open.

data.name: MT7_Vileplume_001
data.value: My plants...[pause=20] they've all been sad lately.

data.name: MT7_Vileplume_002
data.value: Do you think it's connected to what's happening in the ruins?

data.name: MT7_Vileplume_003
data.value: The begonias are beautiful this season![pause=10] Don't you think?

data.name: MT7_Gulpin_001
data.value: I heard you beat a Titan![pause=15] That really works up an appetite!

data.name: MT7_Gulpin_002
data.value: You know what's good in the ruins?[pause=20] Nothing. Nothing is edible.

data.name: MT7_Lickitung_001
data.value: The café has a new dish![pause=10] I think.[pause=15] I go every day.

data.name: MT7_Nidoqueen_001
data.value: Those ruins...[pause=20] You shouldn't have gone in there alone.

data.name: MT7_Nidoqueen_002
data.value: A mother always worries.[pause=25] Even for other people's children.

data.name: MT7_Nidoqueen_003
data.value: Take care out there.[pause=20] You never know what's lurking.

data.name: MT7_Mawile_001
data.value: Mew?![pause=10] THE legendary Mew?![pause=20] Phileas told you that?!

data.name: MT7_Mawile_002
data.value: I knew it![pause=15] Well, no I didn't,[pause=10] but I'm going to pretend I did!

data.name: MT7_Mawile_003
data.value: The whole town is talking about you![pause=15] The Titan of the Ruins!

data.name: MT7_Mawile_004
data.value: Have you heard any rumors?[pause=15] Me neither. Nothing's happening.

data.name: MT7_Floatzel_001
data.value: The river...[pause=20] it's colder than before. Like something's draining the heat.

data.name: MT7_Floatzel_002
data.value: It's from the ruins, isn't it?[pause=25] I knew it.

data.name: MT7_Floatzel_003
data.value: The fishing is good today![pause=10] Want to come along?

data.name: MT7_Quagsire_001
data.value: ...[pause=30] It's okay.[pause=20] I watch the pond. You watch the world.

data.name: MT7_Nidorina_001
data.value: Dad says you're the strongest in the guild![pause=10] Is it true?!

data.name: MT7_Nidorina_002
data.value: One day,[pause=20] I'll be as strong as you![pause=10] You'll see!

data.name: MT7_Nidorina_003
data.value: You're going on another mission?[pause=15] So cool!

data.name: MT7_Electrike_001
data.value: The energy in the air is weird today.[pause=20] Do you feel it too?

data.name: MT7_Electrike_002
data.value: It's like...[pause=25] a storm that never breaks.

data.name: MT7_Machamp_001
data.value: Haha![pause=10] NOW that's what I call a team![pause=15] You make me proud!

data.name: MT7_Machamp_002
data.value: Keep pushing your limits![pause=20] That's how you get stronger.

data.name: MT7_Machamp_003
data.value: Training never stops![pause=10] Even after a great victory.

data.name: MT7_Adagio_001
data.value: The Cloven Ruins...[pause=25] Even we haven't set foot there.

data.name: MT7_Adagio_002
data.value: You have...[pause=15] earned our attention.[pause=30] That's rare.

data.name: MT7_Adagio_003
data.value: We're watching.[pause=25] Keep impressing us.

data.name: MT7_Aria_001
data.value: Oh, it's you![pause=15] The little heroes of the ruins![pause=20] Adorable.

data.name: MT7_Aria_002
data.value: I have to admit...[pause=25] you're not half bad.[pause=35] For beginners.

data.name: MT7_Aria_003
data.value: Still here?[pause=20] You're persistent.[pause=30] It's...[pause=15] charming.

data.name: MT7_Sonata_001
data.value: Regigigas?[pause=10] I would've pranked him,[pause=15] he would've loved it!

data.name: MT7_Sonata_002
data.value: ...What?[pause=20] Titans deserve to have fun too!

data.name: MT7_Sonata_003
data.value: I hid something in town.[pause=25] Good luck finding it!

data.name: MT6_057
data.value: I saw Team Dazzling in the square![pause=10] They're even more impressive in person!

data.name: MT6_058
data.value: Adagio never smiles,[pause=10] but everyone respects her.[pause=20] That's a real leader.

data.name: MT6_059
data.value: Aria looked at me once.[pause=30] I didn't sleep all night.

data.name: MT6_060
data.value: Sonata hid all the Apples from Kecleon's stand yesterday.[pause=15] He was FURIOUS![pause=10] But nobody could prove anything.

data.name: MT6_061
data.value: Papilusion is worried about her little one...[pause=20] The Gloomy Forest is no place for a Venipede.

data.name: MT6_062
data.value: Team Dazzling could save that Venipede in ten minutes![pause=15] Why are they refusing?

data.name: MT6_063
data.value: Elite teams don't move for a Venipede.[pause=25] It makes sense,[pause=10] but it's sad.

data.name: MT6_064
data.value: {0} and {1} are going, right?[pause=15] They're brave. Or crazy. Or both.

data.name: MT6_065
data.value: The Gloomy Forest...[pause=25] My uncle went there once.[pause=30] He never talks about it.

data.name: MT6_066
data.value: They say a mysterious Pokémon guards the forest.[pause=20] A nature spirit.

data.name: MT6_067
data.value: If you save that Venipede,[pause=15] you'll be the village heroes![pause=10] Well, for a week.

data.name: MT6_068
data.value: Take Oran Berries![pause=10] Lots of Oran Berries.[pause=20] The forest shows no mercy.

data.name: MT6_069
data.value: YOU DID IT![pause=10] Venipede is back![pause=15] I cried.[pause=20] I really did.

data.name: MT6_070
data.value: Papilusion hasn't stopped smiling since you got back.[pause=20] You gave her world back to her.

data.name: MT6_071
data.value: Did Team Dazzling see that?[pause=15] They must be green with envy![pause=10] At least I hope so.

data.name: MT6_072
data.value: Adagio nodded when she heard the news.[pause=25] For her,[pause=10] that's the equivalent of a standing ovation.

data.name: MT6_073
data.value: Aria said it was 'cute'.[pause=20] But she said it...[pause=25] differently. Almost with respect.

data.name: MT6_074
data.value: Sonata left a Surprise Package in front of the guild.[pause=20] I don't dare open it.

data.name: MT6_075
data.value: Zarude...[pause=30] You REALLY fought Zarude?[pause=15] The Guardian of the Forest?

data.name: MT6_076
data.value: To think you were beginners just a few weeks ago...[pause=25] Look at you now.

data.name: MT6_077
data.value: The village feels more alive since you've been here.[pause=20] And I'm not just saying that to be nice.

data.name: MT6_078
data.value: Venipede plays with the other kids now.[pause=15] He tells everyone that YOU rescued him.

data.name: MT6_079
data.value: My dad says you're the best team since Penticus.[pause=20] And he's not the complimenting type.

data.name: MT6_080
data.value: The Gloomy Forest has calmed down.[pause=25] You did more than save Venipede. You soothed the forest.

data.name: MT6_081
data.value: The berries taste sweeter today.[pause=15] Maybe it's a coincidence.[pause=25] Or not.

data.name: MT6_082
data.value: Every time you come back from a mission,[pause=10] you seem... bigger.[pause=25] It's strange.

data.name: MT6_083
data.value: I wish I were as brave as you.[pause=20] But the Gloomy Forest...[pause=25] just the name gives me chills.

data.name: MT6_084
data.value: Did you hear the Voice too?[pause=20] In the forest?[pause=25] No, me neither. But I heard THAT...

data.name: MT6_085
data.value: Adagio said something about you.[pause=30] She said: 'They have potential.'[pause=25] POTENTIAL![pause=15] Adagio NEVER says that.

data.name: MT6_086
data.value: Aria still teases you,[pause=10] but it's different now.[pause=20] Before it was contempt. Now it's...[pause=25] play.

data.name: MT6_087
data.value: Sonata asked me your name.[pause=20] Not 'the newbie' or 'the beginner'.[pause=25] Your REAL name.

data.name: MT6_088
data.value: The three left for the coast.[pause=15] But they said they'd be back.[pause=25] For you.

data.name: MT6_089
data.value: You earned their respect.[pause=20] Not their friendship — not yet.[pause=30] But their respect,[pause=15] that's already huge.

data.name: MT6_090
data.value: Team Dazzling never greets first.[pause=20] Adagio greeted you.[pause=30] That says everything.

data.name: MT6_091
data.value: Penticus called a meeting when you got back.[pause=15] He wanted everyone to hear the story of your mission.

data.name: MT6_092
data.value: Rin prepped her infirmary in a hurry.[pause=20] But you came back without a scratch.[pause=25] She was almost disappointed.

data.name: MT6_093
data.value: Coco ordered a round at the Café to celebrate![pause=10] Well, a round for herself. But she paid!

data.name: MT6_094
data.value: Almotz told his family about your feat.[pause=15] His mother cried. From pride, I think.

data.name: MT6_095
data.value: Ganlon said: 'Not bad.'[pause=30] GANLON.[pause=20] 'Not bad.'[pause=25] That's the nicest compliment he's ever given.

data.name: MT6_096
data.value: Shuca asked me if I'd seen Zarude up close.[pause=20] I said no,[pause=15] and she looked relieved. For me.

data.name: MT6_097
data.value: Kino offered special training at the Dojo.[pause=15] To prepare you for what's coming.[pause=30] He didn't specify WHAT.

data.name: MT6_098
data.value: Reinier spent the evening reading ancient texts.[pause=20] He was looking for something about the Voice you heard.

data.name: MT6_099
data.value: Phileas is watching you.[pause=25] Not in a creepy way,[pause=15] more like someone waiting for something.

data.name: MT6_100
data.value: The guild has never been this united.[pause=20] You did that.[pause=30] You brought this team together.

data.name: MT7_077
data.value: Did you feel that?[pause=20] The air is...[pause=15] different. Heavier.

data.name: MT7_078
data.value: My plants lost their color this morning.[pause=25] As if something was draining their life.

data.name: MT7_079
data.value: Phileas didn't sleep last night.[pause=20] I saw him.[pause=25] He was staring at the horizon.

data.name: MT7_080
data.value: The Cloven Ruins...[pause=30] My grandmother said you should never go there.

data.name: MT7_081
data.value: An Anima Heart?[pause=15] What's that?[pause=25] It sounds... important. And terrifying.

data.name: MT7_082
data.value: Penticus looks worried.[pause=20] Penticus is NEVER worried.[pause=30] That scares me.

data.name: MT7_083
data.value: Take care of yourselves in there.[pause=25] The ruins...[pause=20] they change Pokémon.

data.name: MT7_084
data.value: I had a nightmare last night.[pause=15] Purple veins.[pause=30] Everywhere.

data.name: MT7_085
data.value: If even Penticus is scared,[pause=20] then it's really serious.

data.name: MT7_086
data.value: The river water is colder.[pause=25] Much colder. That's not normal.

data.name: MT7_087
data.value: Wild Pokémon are more aggressive than before.[pause=20] Even Rattata attack without reason.

data.name: MT7_088
data.value: {0}, you're our only hope.[pause=30] I know that's a lot of pressure,[pause=15] but it's the truth.

data.name: MT7_089
data.value: The air is breathable again![pause=15] Thank you.[pause=25] I don't know what you did,[pause=10] but thank you.

data.name: MT7_090
data.value: My plants![pause=10] THEY'RE BLOOMING AGAIN![pause=15] Look, new sprouts everywhere!

data.name: MT7_091
data.value: You really fought a Titan?[pause=20] Alone.[pause=30] And you WON?

data.name: MT7_092
data.value: Regigigas...[pause=25] That name makes me tremble just saying it.[pause=30] And you defeated it.

data.name: MT7_093
data.value: The Heart beats again![pause=15] I can feel it.[pause=25] I don't know how,[pause=10] but I can feel it.

data.name: MT7_094
data.value: Phileas stayed silent.[pause=20] But he smiled.[pause=30] Phileas SMILED.

data.name: MT7_095
data.value: Rin said you barely had any injuries.[pause=15] 'Barely'.[pause=25] She's a perfectionist.

data.name: MT7_096
data.value: Coco said you deserved a medal.[pause=15] She's probably going to order you one.

data.name: MT7_097
data.value: I don't know what was happening in those ruins,[pause=15] but I'm glad it's over.

data.name: MT7_098
data.value: The river is warm again![pause=15] Everything's going back to normal.

data.name: MT7_099
data.value: You've changed.[pause=25] Since the expedition started.[pause=30] You're not the same Pokémon anymore.

data.name: MT7_100
data.value: Mew...[pause=30] Life really comes from Mew?[pause=20] That's the most beautiful secret in the world.

data.name: MT7_101
data.value: I can't believe Phileas knew all this from the start.[pause=25] Why didn't he say so sooner?

data.name: MT7_102
data.value: The Anima Hearts are fragments of Mew?[pause=20] That means Mew is...[pause=30] everywhere?

data.name: MT7_103
data.value: If the Hearts can die,[pause=20] then everything can die.[pause=35] That's terrifying.

data.name: MT7_104
data.value: Phileas chose you to hear that story.[pause=20] Not us.[pause=30] Think about that.

data.name: MT7_105
data.value: What you saw in the ruins...[pause=25] was a Heart fading.[pause=30] And you saved it.

data.name: MT7_106
data.value: I understand better now.[pause=20] Why the Voice follows you.[pause=30] You're connected to the Hearts.

data.name: MT7_107
data.value: Relicanth said he already knew.[pause=25] Of course he knew.[pause=20] He always knows everything.

data.name: MT7_108
data.value: And now?[pause=25] What do we do with this knowledge?[pause=30] We protect the Hearts. All of them.

data.name: MT7_109
data.value: You look tired today.[pause=20] Is everything okay?

data.name: MT7_110
data.value: Bad night?[pause=15] Me too.[pause=25] Nightmares. Shadows.[pause=30] Anyway.

data.name: MT7_111
data.value: Something changed in the air last night.[pause=20] Like a presence.[pause=30] Watching us.

data.name: MT7_112
data.value: Did you feel that?[pause=20] Last night, around three...[pause=25] a chill. All over the village.

data.name: MT7_113
data.value: I don't sleep so well anymore since the ruins.[pause=25] And last night...[pause=30] was worse.

data.name: MT8_Noctowl_001
data.value: The Crystal Sanctuary...[pause=25] Have you heard of it?

data.name: MT8_Noctowl_002
data.value: That is where the first wardens of the Hearts set down their knowledge.[pause=30] Lost for centuries.

data.name: MT8_Noctowl_003
data.value: Diancie is the warden of the Sanctuary.[pause=20] She will admit only pure hearts.

data.name: MT8_Noctowl_004
data.value: The Crystal Fragment...[pause=25] If you find it, it will guide you to the next Heart.

data.name: MT8_Noctowl_005
data.value: Pentricus knows the way.[pause=20] He will take you there.

data.name: MT8_Noctowl_006
data.value: You defeated Diancie.[pause=20] I knew you had it in you.

data.name: MT8_Noctowl_007
data.value: The Sanctuary is free.[pause=25] But this is only the beginning.

data.name: MT8_Noctowl_008
data.value: The Crystal Fragment you carry...[pause=30] it leads to the Forgotten Marsh.

data.name: MT8_Noctowl_009
data.value: A Heart is drowning down there.[pause=25] The corruption is different. More... liquid.

data.name: MT8_Noctowl_010
data.value: Rest.[pause=30] Then follow the Fragment. It knows where to go.

data.name: MT8_Noctowl_011
data.value: Stay watchful.[pause=25] Crystals protect, but they can imprison too.

data.name: MT8_Tropius_001
data.value: The Crystal Sanctuary![pause=15] I haven't been there in years.

data.name: MT8_Tropius_002
data.value: It's in the foothills of Mount Windswept.[pause=25] A hidden entrance behind the waterfall.

data.name: MT8_Tropius_003
data.value: Haha! Diancie herself![pause=15] You impressed her, that's certain!

data.name: MT8_Tropius_004
data.value: I've never seen a Crystal Fragment this close.[pause=30] It's magnificent.

data.name: MT8_Tropius_005
data.value: Off you go![pause=15] The sanctuary awaits![pause=20] I'll mind the guild.

data.name: MT8_Audino_001
data.value: Oh! The Crystal Fragment![pause=15] It's... it's alive, isn't it?

data.name: MT8_Audino_002
data.value: I feel it humming when I get close.[pause=30] It's strangely reassuring.

data.name: MT8_Audino_003
data.value: The Sanctuary...[pause=20] They say the crystals can freeze a Pokemon where it stands.

data.name: MT8_Audino_004
data.value: Be careful.[pause=25] Come back to me in one piece!

data.name: MT8_Audino_005
data.value: Phileas is worried.[pause=20] That means it's serious.

data.name: MT8_Audino_006
data.value: Take these Oran Berries.[pause=15] And these Sitrus Berries.[pause=25] And... everything I've got.

data.name: MT8_Audino_007
data.value: The infirmary is ready![pause=15] Well... I hope I won't need it.

data.name: MT8_Snubbull_001
data.value: A Crystal Fragment?![pause=15] I could sell that for a fortune at the Kec Shop!

data.name: MT8_Snubbull_002
data.value: ...I'm joking![pause=20] Well...[pause=30] half joking.

data.name: MT8_Snubbull_003
data.value: The Crystal Sanctuary![pause=15] I've got customers who dream about it at night.

data.name: MT8_Snubbull_004
data.value: They say the walls sing.[pause=25] You'll tell me about it?

data.name: MT8_Snubbull_005
data.value: The stall is open![pause=10] Poke well spent is Poke well earned!

data.name: MT8_Zigzagoon_001
data.value: I'd have loved to go with you!

data.name: MT8_Zigzagoon_002
data.value: My family told me you were heroes.[pause=25] I already knew that.

data.name: MT8_Zigzagoon_003
data.value: Go easy in there.[pause=20] Crystals cut.

data.name: MT8_Zigzagoon_004
data.value: I train every day![pause=15] Soon I'LL be the one going on missions!

data.name: MT8_Relicanth_001
data.value: The Fragment...[pause=30] it pulses.[pause=20] Like a second heart.

data.name: MT8_Relicanth_002
data.value: It will lead you to the next Heart.[pause=25] The one drowning in the marsh.

data.name: MT8_Relicanth_003
data.value: Every Fragment you gather brings you closer to the truth.

data.name: MT8_Relicanth_004
data.value: The Sanctuary...[pause=25] I visited it centuries ago. Literally.

data.name: MT8_Relicanth_005
data.value: Diancie is an ally.[pause=20] Treat her with respect and she will return it.

data.name: MT8_Relicanth_006
data.value: The currents speak of ancient crystals...[pause=30] Listen to them.

data.name: MT8_Bisharp_001
data.value: Diancie defeated.[pause=20] You saved a protected site.[pause=30] Officially.

data.name: MT8_Bisharp_002
data.value: The Sanctuary is under my watch from now on.[pause=25] You can rest easy.

data.name: MT8_Bisharp_003
data.value: The Crystal Sanctuary is a protected site.[pause=20] Break nothing.

data.name: MT8_Bisharp_004
data.value: I've sent a patrol into the foothills.[pause=30] As a precaution.

data.name: MT8_Bisharp_005
data.value: Metano's safety is my priority.[pause=20] Report anything suspicious.

data.name: MT8_Ledian_001
data.value: Diancie's style...[pause=20] I'd love to study it. Will you describe her to me?

data.name: MT8_Ledian_002
data.value: The Dojo has new techniques inspired by the crystals.[pause=25] Come and try them!

data.name: MT8_Ledian_003
data.value: The Crystal Sanctuary demands perfect discipline.[pause=20] Are you ready?

data.name: MT8_Ledian_004
data.value: Every crystal is a test.[pause=25] Every test sharpens your technique.

data.name: MT8_Ledian_005
data.value: Training is the key![pause=15] The dojo is open.

data.name: MT8_Nidoqueen_001
data.value: I'm so proud of you.[pause=25] Even my little ones talk about you!

data.name: MT8_Nidoqueen_002
data.value: You're the role models this town needed.

data.name: MT8_Nidoqueen_003
data.value: The Crystal Sanctuary...[pause=20] you shouldn't have gone in alone.

data.name: MT8_Nidoqueen_004
data.value: A mother always worries.[pause=25] Even about other people's children.

data.name: MT8_Nidoqueen_005
data.value: Take care of yourselves out there.[pause=20] You never know what's prowling about.

data.value: Incredible![pause=15] My wife won't stop talking about you!

data.name: MT8_Nidoking_002
data.value: Come to the inn tonight![pause=10] Dinner's on me!

data.name: MT8_Nidoking_003
data.value: The inn is quiet today.[pause=20] Too quiet.

data.name: MT8_Nidoking_004
data.value: Welcome to the Nidoking Inn![pause=10] The best bed in Metano!

data.name: MT8_Nidorina_001
data.value: I want to be as strong as you![pause=10] Dad says it's possible!

data.name: MT8_Nidorina_002
data.value: Show me a technique![pause=15] Just one! Please!

data.name: MT8_Nidorina_003
data.value: You're going to the Crystal Sanctuary?[pause=15] I want to go too!

data.name: MT8_Nidorina_004
data.value: Dad says you're the best team since Pentricus.

data.name: MT8_NidoranM_001
data.value: My sister admires you so much![pause=15] So do I, I just say it more quietly.

data.name: MT8_NidoranM_002
data.value: Go on![pause=15] Show them what you can do!

data.value: I had a dream...[pause=25] crystals everywhere. It was beautiful.

data.name: MT8_Furret_002
data.value: Now I can sleep easy.[pause=30] Thank you.

data.value: Aaah...[pause=0] the sun is lovely today.

data.name: MT8_Furret_004
data.value: Aaah...[pause=0] this is my favourite napping spot~

data.value: Relicanth lent me a work on sanctuaries.[pause=25] Fascinating.

data.name: MT8_Linoone_004
data.value: This spot by the river is perfect for reading.

data.value: Be careful with the crystals.[pause=25] They say they can consume you.

data.value: Haha! NOW that's a team worthy of the name!

data.name: MT8_Machamp_002
data.value: Any time you want a training bout![pause=10] I won't go easy on you!

data.name: MT8_Machamp_003
data.value: The Crystal Sanctuary![pause=15] I'd love to go smash a few rocks in there!

data.name: MT8_Machamp_004
data.value: Give it everything![pause=10] Raw power always works!

data.name: MT8_Machamp_005
data.value: Training never stops![pause=10] Not even for heroes.

data.value: Your energy is clearer.[pause=25] The Sanctuary purified you.

data.value: Meditation reveals what words conceal.[pause=30] You should try it.

data.name: MT8_Medicham_005
data.value: Empty the mind...[pause=30] and everything becomes clear.

data.value: I want to be like you when I grow up![pause=15] But mum wants me to meditate...

data.value: Do you think I can be an adventurer AND a meditator?

data.value: Meditation...[pause=20] it's hard. But dad says it makes you stronger.

data.value: ..........[pause=40] (Meditite is deep in meditation.)

data.value: I knew it![pause=15] Well, no, I only just found out,[pause=10] BUT STILL!

data.value: The whole town is talking about NOTHING but you![pause=15] It's HUGE!

data.value: A sanctuary HIDDEN behind a waterfall?[pause=20] That's so romantic!

data.name: MT8_Mawile_005
data.value: I'm going to investigate![pause=15] Bria, ace reporter!

data.value: Have you heard the latest rumours?[pause=15] No?[pause=20] Me neither.

data.value: The guild stands behind you.[pause=15] Always. Never forget that.

data.value: Any messages for you?[pause=15] No, nothing today.

data.name: MT9_Noctowl_001
data.value: The Forgotten Marsh...[pause=25] The Crystal Fragment leads there.

data.name: MT9_Noctowl_002
data.value: A Heart is drowning down there.[pause=20] The corruption is... different.

data.name: MT9_Noctowl_003
data.value: Go.[pause=25] But stay on your guard.

data.name: MT9_Noctowl_004
data.value: The Marsh...[pause=20] I went once. I shall not go again.

data.name: MT9_Noctowl_005
data.value: The water is toxic.[pause=25] The mist is thick. And something...[pause=30] prowls there.

data.name: MT9_Noctowl_006
data.value: Take Antidotes.[pause=20] Plenty of Antidotes.

data.name: MT9_Noctowl_007
data.value: The Circle of the Shroud...[pause=30] So they truly exist.

data.name: MT9_Noctowl_008
data.value: I never thought the legend was true.[pause=25] Three spectres, fallen wardens of the primordial seal.

data.name: MT9_Noctowl_009
data.value: They are NOT your allies.[pause=30] But they may not be your enemies either.

data.name: MT9_Noctowl_010
data.value: Mega Blastoise...[pause=20] you defeated him. The Heart breathes again.

data.name: MT9_Noctowl_011
data.value: But it is weak.[pause=25] Very weak. It will need time to heal.

data.name: MT9_Noctowl_012
data.value: The Heart of the Marsh beats again.[pause=25] Thanks to you.

data.name: MT9_Noctowl_013
data.value: But the Circle's words...[pause=30] 'Every Heart you heal brings the end closer.' What did they mean?

data.name: MT9_Noctowl_014
data.value: I shall consult the archives.[pause=25] Something is escaping us.

data.name: MT9_Noctowl_015
data.value: Stay watchful.[pause=25] The marsh mist hides many secrets.

data.name: MT9_Tropius_001
data.value: Mega Blastoise![pause=10] You defeated Mega Blastoise![pause=15] INCREDIBLE!

data.name: MT9_Tropius_002
data.value: And this Circle of the Shroud...[pause=25] Phileas told me about them. I didn't believe it.

data.name: MT9_Tropius_003
data.value: Go and rest.[pause=20] You've earned it.

data.name: MT9_Tropius_004
data.value: The Circle of the Shroud...[pause=25] Spectres? In OUR region?

data.name: MT9_Tropius_005
data.value: I'll step up the patrols.[pause=30] You never know.

data.name: MT9_Tropius_006
data.value: The Forgotten Marsh![pause=10] Brace yourselves for a rough time!

data.name: MT9_Tropius_007
data.value: Off you go![pause=15] The guild is counting on you.

data.name: MT9_Audino_001
data.value: You survived the Marsh![pause=15] AND the Circle of the Shroud?!

data.name: MT9_Audino_002
data.value: I...[pause=20] I don't even know what to say. You're incredible.

data.name: MT9_Audino_003
data.value: Let me check you for poisoning.[pause=25] No, you're fine.

data.name: MT9_Audino_004
data.value: Spectres?![pause=20] In the marsh?[pause=25] That's... that's terrifying!

data.name: MT9_Audino_005
data.value: Are you SURE you want to go back?[pause=30] ...All right. Take some Pecha Berries.

data.name: MT9_Audino_006
data.value: The marsh water is toxic.[pause=25] Don't touch it under any circumstances!

data.name: MT9_Audino_007
data.value: The infirmary is ready![pause=15] The antidotes too.

data.name: MT9_Snubbull_001
data.value: Mega Blastoise?![pause=15] That must be worth a fortune in scales!

data.name: MT9_Snubbull_002
data.value: ...I'm kidding![pause=20] ... Half kidding.[pause=30] ...A quarter.

data.name: MT9_Snubbull_003
data.value: The Circle of the Shroud?![pause=15] SPECTRES?![pause=20] Real ones?!

data.name: MT9_Snubbull_004
data.value: I'm going to tell EVERYONE![pause=10] ...Carefully. From a distance.

data.name: MT9_Snubbull_005
data.value: The Forgotten Marsh![pause=15] Take boots. That mud is clingy.

data.name: MT9_Snubbull_006
data.value: The stall is open![pause=10] Everything for the adventure!

data.value: You faced SPECTRES?![pause=15] My family will lose their minds!

data.name: MT9_Zigzagoon_002
data.value: Tell me EVERYTHING![pause=20] Well, if you want to.

data.name: MT9_Zigzagoon_003
data.value: The marsh...[pause=20] Watch out for the mud.

data.name: MT9_Zigzagoon_004
data.value: I'm training![pause=15] One day I'll fight spectres too!

data.value: The Heart of the Marsh...[pause=30] it survived. That is a miracle.

data.name: MT9_Relicanth_002
data.value: The Circle of the Shroud is not your enemy.[pause=25] Not yet.

data.name: MT9_Relicanth_003
data.value: They believe they serve the balance.[pause=30] But balance is an illusion.

data.name: MT9_Relicanth_004
data.value: The Circle of the Shroud...[pause=25] I thought them gone for centuries.

data.name: MT9_Relicanth_005
data.value: Beware.[pause=30] Their purpose is not yours.

data.name: MT9_Relicanth_006
data.value: The currents speak of a poisoned marsh...[pause=30] Be careful.

data.name: MT9_Relicanth_007
data.value: The currents are speaking...[pause=25] Listen closely.

data.value: I've filed the 'Circle of the Shroud' case.[pause=25] Top priority.

data.value: Spectres are prowling the marsh.[pause=20] Officially confirmed.

data.value: I'm doubling the patrols.[pause=30] If those spectres come near Metano...

data.value: The Forgotten Marsh is a biohazard zone.[pause=20] Equip yourselves.

data.name: MT9_Bisharp_006
data.value: Metano's safety is my priority.[pause=20] Report anything suspicious.

data.value: Mega Blastoise's style...[pause=20] Brutal but effective.

data.value: The Dojo has a new simulation: 'Survival in Toxic Terrain'.[pause=25] Interested?

data.value: The Marsh demands endurance and speed.[pause=20] You have both.

data.name: MT9_Ledian_004
data.value: Training is the key![pause=15] The dojo is open.

data.value: Mega Blastoise![pause=10] I'd have PAID to see that fight!

data.name: MT9_Machamp_002
data.value: Any time you fancy an arm-wrestle![pause=10] Just to compare!

data.name: MT9_Machamp_003
data.value: Spectres?![pause=15] Let them come![pause=20] I'm waiting!

data.value: My letterbox...[pause=25] someone vandalised it AGAIN! It wasn't a spectre, I hope?

data.name: MT9_Machamp_005
data.value: Give it everything in that marsh![pause=10] Raw power crushes anything!

data.name: MT9_Machamp_006
data.value: Training never stops![pause=10] Not even in the rain.

data.value: The Heart of the Marsh is purified.[pause=25] I can feel it. Balance is returning.

data.name: MT9_Medicham_002
data.value: Even spectres have a reason to exist.[pause=30] Meditate on that.

data.name: MT9_Medicham_003
data.value: The Circle of the Shroud...[pause=25] their aura is... conflicted. Not malevolent.

data.name: MT9_Medicham_004
data.value: They are lost.[pause=30] Not wicked. Lost.

data.name: MT9_Medicham_005
data.value: Empty the mind...[pause=30] and everything becomes clear.

data.value: Dad says you fight fear with meditation.[pause=25] ...It doesn't always work.

data.value: I'm afraid of spectres.[pause=25] ...That's normal, isn't it?

data.name: MT9_Meditite_004
data.value: Meditation...[pause=20] it helps you not be afraid.

data.value: My little ones look up to you![pause=15] Even Nidoran, who pretends not to.

data.value: Come and see us at the inn![pause=15] We'll lay on a feast!

data.value: The marsh...[pause=20] Nidorina wanted to follow you. I stopped her.

data.value: She's furious with me.[pause=25] But I'd rather that than lose her.

data.name: MT9_Nidoqueen_005
data.value: Take care of yourselves out there.[pause=20] A mother always worries.

data.name: MT9_Nidoking_002

data.value: Welcome to the inn![pause=10] The best bed in Metano!

data.value: Dad LOCKED ME IN![pause=10] I wanted to help you in the marsh!

data.name: MT9_Nidorina_002
data.value: Next time,[pause=20] I'm coming. Promise. On the quiet.

data.value: My parents won't let me come with you![pause=10] It's NOT FAIR!

data.name: MT9_Nidorina_004
data.value: You're my heroes![pause=15] My parents don't understand.

data.value: Spectres?[pause=15] Not scared![pause=20] ...All right, a bit.

data.value: I want to be strong like you![pause=10] To protect mum!

data.value: Numel talks of nothing but you.[pause=25] And his 'muscles'.

data.value: He's changed.[pause=30] Because of you.[pause=40] Thank you.

data.name: MT9_Camerupt_003
data.value: Those spectres...[pause=25] did they hurt you?

data.name: MT9_Camerupt_004
data.value: Numel is impatient.[pause=20] One day he'll be ready.

data.value: The marsh water runs clear again![pause=15] Incredible!

data.name: MT9_Floatzel_002
data.value: Maris...[pause=25] she was right. I was overfishing.

data.name: MT9_Floatzel_003
data.value: The Circle of the Shroud...[pause=20] they passed close to the river.

data.value: The water went COLD.[pause=25] Like ice. Like death.

data.name: MT9_Floatzel_005
data.value: The river is carrying toxic sludge.[pause=25] It's coming from the marsh.

data.name: MT9_Floatzel_006
data.value: The fishing is good today![pause=10] Want to join me?

data.value: Spectres...[pause=25] This is no job for novices.

data.value: I know Pokemon who hunt this kind of threat.[pause=25] Professionals.

data.name: MT9_Luxray_005
data.value: Stay on your guard.[pause=25] The marsh is treacherous.

data.value: This spot by the water is perfect for reading.

data.value: The music of the marsh![pause=15] It's... damp. But danceable!

data.value: The apricorns grow better now the marsh is healed!

data.value: The expedition sounds DANGEROUS![pause=15] ...I'd still go.

data.value: Roll, roll all the way to adventure![pause=15] Me, I roll as far as the cafe.

data.value: You're going on the expedition?[pause=15] So cool![pause=20] Come back with stories!

data.value: You survived the heat of the Tunnel?[pause=20] I'm drooling with admiration!

data.value: The expedition...[pause=25] that's far away. I'm going to miss you.

data.name: MT6_118
data.value: We really made it back... The guild is going to be so proud of us!

data.value: You crossed that steppe and came home standing. For a young team, that is no small thing!

data.name: MT6_121
data.value: ...Mm. A brave little ripple can still reach the whole pond.

data.name: LZ_Name_Molten_Throne

data.value: A throne of living magma, they say. The ground itself bows to whoever sits there.

data.value: Deep under the storm line, the sea keeps a room where the tide is born.

data.name: LZ_Name_Western_Silence
data.value: Western Silence

data.value: A cave out west where even the echo refuses to follow you.

data.name: LZ_Sight_Western_Silence
data.value: Man-made halls swallowed by rock. Something very old and very awake waits at the end.

data.name: LZ_Name_Victory_Spark
data.value: Victory Spark

data.name: LZ_Blurb_Victory_Spark
data.value: They say whoever touches that little flame never loses again. Never proven wrong.

data.name: LZ_Sight_Victory_Spark
data.value: A ridge split by an old fault, warm as a heartbeat.

data.name: LZ_Name_Twin_Rift
data.value: Twin Rift

data.value: Two lights cross the strait faster than the eye. Always two.

data.value: The gentler of the two lights. Gentler does not mean weaker.

data.value: The red wake lingers close to the shore, watching.

data.name: LZ_Name_First_Cradle_Hoopa

data.name: LZ_Sight_First_Cradle_Hoopa
data.value: Golden rings hang in the air where no branch could hold them.

data.value: Cocoon of Ruin

data.name: LZ_Blurb_Final_Rest
data.value: Where the land sickens, the great cocoon drinks. Do not sleep there.

data.name: LZ_Sight_Final_Rest
data.value: A hollow of grey trees. Nothing rots — everything simply stops.

data.value: Gathering of Cells

data.name: LZ_Blurb_Cells_Gathering
data.value: The green watcher only assembles when the order of things is threatened.

data.name: LZ_Sight_Cells_Gathering
data.value: High above the clouds, specks of green gather and scatter like a swarm deciding.

data.name: LZ_Name_Two_Lights
data.value: Two Lights — Sun

data.name: LZ_Blurb_Two_Lights
data.value: The tale says the sun walks as a beast with a mane of steel.

data.name: LZ_Sight_Two_Lights
data.value: A summit where dawn comes twice: once for the sky, once for the mane.

data.name: LZ_Name_Two_Lights_Lunala
data.value: Two Lights — Moon

data.name: LZ_Blurb_Two_Lights_Lunala
data.value: And the moon flies, says the tale, on wings of night sewn with stars.

data.name: LZ_Sight_Two_Lights_Lunala
data.value: When the sun-beast rests, the night unfolds two immense wings.

data.name: LZ_Name_Eternal_Coil
data.value: Eternal Coil

data.name: LZ_Blurb_Eternal_Coil
data.value: I will only speak of that place to someone who has finished what they started.

data.name: LZ_Sight_Eternal_Coil
data.value: A vein of the world laid bare. The light there does not behave.

data.name: LZ_Name_Only_Shadow
data.value: Only Shadow

data.value: Nobody has ever seen it. Only its shadow — and only when it wanted.

data.name: LZ_Sight_Only_Shadow
data.value: A hollow where every shadow is a little too deep, a little too quick.

data.value: It fell from farther than the sky. It is still learning our shapes.

data.name: LZ_Sight_Fallen_Visitor
data.value: A crater cave humming with a rhythm that matches no heart of this world.

data.value: Where Thanks Bloom

data.name: LZ_Blurb_Thanks_Bloom
data.value: Bring your gratitude there. The garden knows how to read it.

data.name: LZ_Sight_Thanks_Bloom
data.value: A meadow that blooms out of season whenever someone says a true thank you.

data.value: Sea Cradle

data.value: The sea rocks its firstborn there. Mind the lullaby.

data.name: LZ_Sight_Sea_Cradle

data.value: A colt trains there to deserve its own horn. Respect that.

data.name: LZ_Sight_Resolute_Ford
data.value: A ford where the water stands against the current, as if holding its ground.

data.value: A forge of stone where geysers breathe like bellows.

data.name: MTP_001
data.value: La Team Dazzling...[pause=20] Qu'est-ce qu'elles font en plein centre ?

data.name: MTP_002
data.value: Vous avez quand même un cœur...[pause=25] n'est-ce pas ?

data.name: MTP_003
data.value: S'il vous plaît ![pause=15] Sauvez mon enfant ![pause=20] Il a besoin d'aide !

data.name: MTP_004
data.value: Bah oui ![pause=20] Sans un cœur, on serait déjà décédées !

data.name: MTP_005
data.value: T'avais vraiment trouvé le meilleur moment pour sortir une bêtise...

data.name: MTP_006
data.value: Et puis fallait pas perdre votre gamin.[pause=25] On n'y est pour rien, nous.

data.name: MTP_007
data.value: Vous...[pause=25] vous n'avez pas le droit de lui parler comme ça !

data.name: MTP_008
data.value: ASSEZ !

data.name: MTP_009
data.value: Vous ne voyez pas que vous êtes en train de ruiner toute ma prestance ?

data.name: MTP_010
data.value: Bref...[pause=25] Nous n'avons pas que ça à faire. Nous sommes très occupées.

data.name: MTP_011
data.value: Alors...[pause=30] écartez-vous.

data.name: MTP_012
data.value: Personne n'a besoin de se disputer.[pause=25] On peut juste vous laisser passer.

data.name: MTP_013
data.value: « Juste ».[pause=25] Voilà un mot que je déteste.[pause=20] On ne fait rien « juste ».

data.name: MTP_014
data.value: Elle vous a demandé de l'aide.[pause=25] Vous auriez pu dire non poliment.

data.name: MTP_015
data.value: On a dit non poliment, non ?[pause=20] Enfin...[pause=15] on a dit non.

data.name: MTP_016
data.value: Tais-toi, Aria.[pause=25] Chaque fois que tu parles, on recule d'un pas.

data.name: MTP_017
data.value: Vous portez un badge d'explorateur.[pause=25] Montrez-moi qu'il vaut quelque chose.

data.name: MTP_018
data.value: (Elle ne cherche pas à passer.[pause=25] Elle cherche à voir.)

data.name: MTP_019
data.value: Écartez-vous,[pause=15] ou faites-moi écarter.[pause=25] L'un des deux.

data.name: MTP_020
data.value: Alors ce sera la deuxième.[pause=25] On ne bouge pas d'ici.

data.name: MTP_021
data.value: Enfin une réponse claire.[pause=30] Voyons ce qu'elle vaut.

data.name: MTP_030
data.value: Le sol est froid.[pause=30] Vos jambes ne répondent plus.

data.name: MTP_031
data.value: Attends...[pause=25] Attends, je me relève...[pause=20] Je me relève !

data.name: MTP_032
data.value: Vous étiez sur mon chemin.[pause=30] Vous y êtes toujours.

data.name: MTP_033
data.value: Oh ![pause=15] On fait comme ça, alors ?[pause=20] D'accord !

data.name: MTP_034
data.value: Relevez-vous avant qu'on revienne.[pause=30] Ça nous fera une surprise.

data.name: MTP_035
data.value: Des pas.[pause=25] Beaucoup de pas. Toute la place accourt vers vous.

data.name: MTP_036
data.value: (Leurs voix s'éloignent...[pause=30] non.[pause=20] C'est moi qui pars.)

data.name: MTP_037
data.value: Quelques heures plus tard...

data.name: MTP_040
data.value: Des voix.[pause=30] Elles parlaient déjà avant que vous ouvriez les yeux.

data.name: MTP_041
data.value: (Le plafond de la chambre.[pause=30] Je ne me souviens pas d'être rentré.)

data.name: MTP_042
data.value: Il est réveillé ![pause=20] Wouf ![pause=15] Je vais prévenir tout le monde !

data.name: MTP_043
data.value: On a perdu, hein ?[pause=30] On a vraiment perdu.

data.name: MTP_044
data.value: Rien de cassé.[pause=25] De l'épuisement, surtout. Beaucoup d'épuisement.

data.name: MTP_045
data.value: Ce sont les habitants qui vous ont ramenés.[pause=25] À plusieurs. En courant.

data.name: MTP_046
data.value: Trois adversaires, deux défenseurs.[pause=25] Pourquoi ne pas avoir reculé ?

data.name: MTP_047
data.value: (Parce qu'il y avait quelqu'un derrière nous.[pause=25] Voilà pourquoi.)

data.name: MTP_048
data.value: Vous avez tenu devant plus fort que vous.[pause=25] Ce n'est pas une faute.

data.name: MTP_049
data.value: Mais tenir ne suffit pas.[pause=30] La prochaine fois, il faudra gagner.

data.name: MTP_050
data.value: On s'entraînera.[pause=25] Autant qu'il faudra.

data.name: MTP_051
data.value: Voilà ce que je voulais entendre.[pause=30] Reposez-vous. C'est un ordre.

data.name: MTP_060
data.value: Le silence dure.[pause=30] Personne, sur cette place, ne s'attendait à ça.

data.name: MTP_061
data.value: Le soleil m'a gênée ![pause=20] Enfin...[pause=15] il y avait du soleil, non ?

data.name: MTP_062
data.value: Il fait gris depuis ce matin, Aria.

data.name: MTP_063
data.value: Un jour sans.[pause=25] Ça arrive à tout le monde.[pause=20] Même à nous.

data.name: MTP_064
data.value: Non, Sonata.[pause=30] Ce n'était pas un jour sans.

data.name: MTP_065
data.value: Vous êtes plus intéressants que prévu.[pause=25] J'avais mal regardé.

data.name: MTP_066
data.value: (Elle ne s'excuse pas.[pause=25] Elle corrige. C'est pire.)

data.name: MTP_067
data.value: Ceci ne règle rien.[pause=30] Ça repousse simplement le vrai duel.

data.name: MTP_068
data.value: Elles sont parties...[pause=25] et j'ai encore les pattes qui tremblent.

data.name: MTP_T01
data.value: J'étais juste là.[pause=25] J'aurais pu faire quelque chose.[pause=20] Je n'ai rien fait.

data.name: MTP_T02
data.value: Vous les avez battues ![pause=20] Elles ! [pause=15]Je l'ai vu de mes yeux !

data.name: MTP_T03
data.value: Elles ne vous ont pas contournés.[pause=30] Elles vous ont marché dessus.

data.name: MTP_T04
data.value: Je croyais qu'elles étaient invincibles.[pause=25] Elles ne le sont pas.

data.name: MTP_T05
data.value: ...[pause=30] On vous a portés jusqu'à la guilde.[pause=20] C'était la moindre des choses.

data.name: MTP_T06
data.value: ...[pause=30] La place s'en souviendra.[pause=25] Moi aussi.

data.name: MTP_T07
data.value: Vous vous êtes mis devant une mère en larmes.[pause=25] Je n'oublierai pas ça.

data.name: MTP_T08
data.value: Vous avez gagné,[pause=15] et vous n'avez pas fanfaronné.[pause=25] C'est rare.

data.name: MTP_T09
data.value: La grande verte a dit qu'on ruinait sa prestance...[pause=25] Elle l'a ruinée seule.

data.name: MTP_T10
data.value: La lapine cherchait une excuse ![pause=20] Il n'y avait même pas de soleil !

data.name: MTP_T11
data.value: Trois contre deux.[pause=30] Personne ne peut vous reprocher ça.

data.name: MTP_T12
data.value: Trois contre deux,[pause=15] et c'est vous qui êtes debout.[pause=25] Incroyable.

data.name: MTP_T13
data.value: Vous vous êtes battus pour mon enfant.[pause=30] Des inconnus. Merci.

data.name: MTP_T14
data.value: Vous avez gagné pour lui.[pause=30] Je vais le retrouver. Grâce à vous.

data.name: MTP_070
data.value: Excusez-moi ![pause=20] Vous êtes de la guilde, n'est-ce pas ?

data.name: MTP_071
data.value: Mon petit n'est pas rentré.[pause=25] Il est parti vers les bois ce matin.

data.name: MTP_072
data.value: On peut y aller tout de suite ![pause=20] Dites-nous seulement où.

data.name: MTP_073
data.value: C'est que...[pause=25] on m'a conseillé une équipe. Une vraie. Des habitués.

data.name: MTP_074
data.value: La Team Dazzling.[pause=30] On dit qu'elles ne reviennent jamais bredouilles.

data.name: MTP_075
data.value: La Team Dazzling ?[pause=25] Ça, madame, c'est du sérieux.

data.name: MTP_076
data.value: Trois donjons de rang supérieur cette saison.[pause=20] Trois.

data.name: MTP_077
data.value: Elles passent ici entre deux missions.[pause=25] Jamais plus de deux jours.

data.name: MTP_078
data.value: La Team Dazzling...[pause=20] ? Qui sont-ils ?

data.name: MTP_079
data.value: Hello darling...[pause=20] Bonjour, bienvenue, bonsoir !

data.name: MTP_080
data.value: Qui sommes-nous ?[pause=25] Voyons, boya, tu vis dans une grotte ou quoi ?

data.name: MTP_081
data.value: Peut-être qu'il est juste bête, vous savez.

data.name: MTP_082
data.value: ORRH, la ferme ![pause=20] Tu vas gâcher notre entrée !

data.name: MTP_090
data.value: Bien.[pause=25] Nous avons assez donné de notre temps.

data.name: MTP_091
data.value: On nous attend à la guilde.[pause=25] J'ai exigé un entretien avec Penticus.

data.name: MTP_092
data.value: Exigé ![pause=20] C'est comme demander, mais en plus joli !

data.name: MTP_093
data.value: Ce n'est pas du tout ça.[pause=25] Avance.

data.name: MTP_094
data.value: Nous sommes attendues.[pause=25] Penticus m'a accordé un entretien.

data.name: MTP_095
data.value: « Accordé ».[pause=30] Tu l'as réclamé trois fois par courrier.

data.name: MTP_096
data.value: On part parce qu'on a gagné, hein ?[pause=25] ...On a gagné, non ?
